Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, target tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activity rows against human single-protein target CHEMBL220 (Acetylcholinesterase). Join activities to assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter by target ChEMBL ID CHEMBL220, target type SINGLE PROTEIN, tax ID 9606, standard type IC50, standard relation equals, and non-null pChEMBL value. Return all matching rows without deduplication. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID then assay ChEMBL ID.
